functions.name: RegisterDelegateOffset
functions.signature: RegisterDelegateOffset(Owning Object, Delegate Name, Offset To Owner)
functions.docs:
Sparse delegates can be used for infrequently bound dynamic delegates so that the object uses only
1 byte of storage instead of having the full overhead of the delegate invocation list.
The cost to invoke, add, remove, etc. from the delegate is higher than using the delegate
directly and thus the memory savings benefit should be traded off against the frequency
with which you would expect the delegate to be bound.

functions.name: Add
functions.docs: Binds a sparse delegate to the owner. Returns if the delegate was successfully bound.

functions.name: AddUnique
functions.docs: Binds a sparse delegate to the owner, verifying first that the delegate is not already bound. Returns if the delegate was successfully bound.

functions.name: Contains
functions.docs: Returns whether a sparse delegate is bound to the owner.

functions.name: Contains
functions.signature: Contains(Delegate Owner, Delegate Name, In Object, In Function Name)

functions.name: Remove
functions.docs: Removes a delegate binding from the owner's sparse delegate storage. Returns true if there are still bindings to the delegate.

functions.name: Remove
functions.signature: Remove(Delegate Owner, Delegate Name, In Object, In Function Name)

functions.name: RemoveAll
functions.signature: RemoveAll(Delegate Owner, Delegate Name, User Object)
functions.docs: Removes all sparse delegate binding from the owner for a given object. Returns true if there are still bindings to the delegate.

functions.name: Clear
functions.docs: Clear all of the named sparse delegate bindings from the owner.

functions.name: GetMulticastDelegate
functions.docs: Acquires the actual Multicast Delegate from the annotation if any delegates are bound to it. Will be null if no entry exists in the annotation for this object/delegatename.

functions.name: GetSharedMulticastDelegate
functions.docs: Acquires the actual Multicast Delegate from the annotation if any delegates are bound to it as a shared pointer. Will be null if no entry exists in the annotation for this object/delegatename.

functions.name: SetMulticastDelegate
functions.docs: Directly sets the Multicast Delegate for this object/delegatename pair. If the delegate is unbound it will be assigned/inserted anyways.

functions.name: ResolveSparseDelegate
functions.docs: Using the registry of sparse delegates recover the FSparseDelegate address from the UObject and name.

functions.name: ResolveSparseOwner
functions.signature: ResolveSparseOwner(Sparse Delegate, Owning Class Name, Delegate Name)
functions.docs: Using the registry of sparse delegates recover the UObject owner from the FSparseDelegate address owning class and delegate names.

functions.name: SparseDelegateReport
functions.docs: Outputs a report about which delegates are bound.
